open_decisions.question: Copybook AUDITLOG declares audit types ('TRAN','USER','SYST'; BR-143), actions (CREATE, UPDATE, DELETE, INQUIRE, LOGIN, LOGOUT, STARTUP, SHUTDOWN; BR-144) and outcome statuses ('SUCC','FAIL','WARN'; BR-145). Callers assign them and AUDPROC writes them unchecked. Must the forward audit service reject values outside these domains, or record whatever the caller supplies (as implemented)?

RPTAUD00 declares AUDIT-FILE (DD AUDITLOG, key AUD-KEY) and ERROR-FILE (DD ERRLOG, key ERR-KEY) without FDs; COPY AUDITLOG and COPY ERRHAND appear directly in the FILE SECTION (lines 35-36). Which copybook record is the record of each file, and where are AUD-KEY and ERR-KEY defined?

WS-ERROR-MESSAGE is used by the error handlers of RPTAUD00 and RPTSTA00 (and RPTPOS00) but is declared nowhere (ERRHAND defines ERR-MESSAGE). What is its declaration (length and type) for the DISPLAY in 9999-ERROR-HANDLER?

Fifteen elementary level-01 items (e.g. HISTLD00 WS-COMMIT-THRESHOLD, the REPORT-RECORD print lines, DB2CONN WS-CONNECTION-STATE/WS-RETRY-COUNT/WS-MAX-RETRIES, DB2CMT WS-SAVEPOINT-ID) are catalogued as record-level items without Field IDs, so no Java type could be assigned. Should the reverse harness register Field IDs for them, or may later stages map them at record level using the catalogued PIC?

RPTAUD00 opens AUDIT-FILE and ERROR-FILE but the paragraphs that read and summarise them and write the report body (2110, 2120, 2210, 2220, 2310, 2320, 2330) are missing; its error handler GOBACKs with RC 12 without closing files. What report content must be produced, and should Java close open files on the error path?

AUDPROC appends audit records to a sequential dataset (DD AUDFILE, OPEN EXTEND per call), its group MOVE LS-SYSTEM-INFO TO AUD-HEADER may overwrite the timestamp just set, and it CLOSEs the file after a failed OPEN; RPTAUD00 meanwhile reads an indexed audit file keyed AUD-KEY (DD AUDITLOG) built on the same copybook. Is there one audit trail (and which organisation), and must the timestamp overwrite be reproduced?

Which character encoding (code page) do the files and areas described by these copybooks use for DISPLAY data on the legacy platform (EBCDIC 037, 1140, another EBCDIC variant, or ASCII)? The zoned-decimal test vectors and String codecs depend on it.

RPTAUD00 performs 7 paragraphs that are not in the source (2110-READ-AUDIT-RECORDS, 2120-SUMMARIZE-AUDIT, 2210-READ-ERROR-RECORDS, 2220-SUMMARIZE-ERRORS, 2310-WRITE-AUDIT-SUMMARY, 2320-WRITE-ERROR-SUMMARY, 2330-WRITE-CONTROL-SUMMARY); no audit or error record is read anywhere; WS-ERROR-MESSAGE is declared nowhere; the error handler ends the run with GOBACK inside a PERFORM without closing files. Can the complete source be supplied, or must the business specify the content of the system audit report?
